label: SYNTHETIC_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
revision_r2_note: R2 gate-6 fix: branch goal views are now structurally distinct by SHAPE FAMILY (A/N=ROUND: white disc sign + blue sphere prop + horizontal stripes; B/W=POINTED: yellow cone sign + green cone prop; distractor E=BOXY: square sign + crate; approach S=CYLINDRICAL: vertical bars + cylinder), not just recoloured end walls.
revision_r3_note: R3 corridor-shell fix: each arm now has branch-tinted side walls + a branch-colour floor strip + a shape-family side-wall relief, and the goal-image cameras are pulled back to ~2.3 m standoff (goalA at (0,1.2), goalB at (-1.2,0)) so the whole corridor shell + signs + props are in-frame.
frame: ENU, meters, yaw 0=+X east / N=90 / W=180 / S=270

routes.goal_view: blue end wall, ROUND identity: big white circular disc sign + blue sphere prop + horizontal industrial stripes
green end wall, POINTED identity: big yellow triangular (cone) sign + green cone prop + dark chevron

shared_approach.note: Both routes share the south approach corridor and diverge only at the decision point (0,0). The discriminative content is the decision frame + branch frames, NOT the shared approach.

distractor.role: optional third option / distractor; NOT part of the primary A-vs-B branch-choice pair

forbidden_goal_pairs_note: Never train a goal pair that is collinear (N vs S, or E vs W). Collinear near/far pairs are the exact trap the Track-B gate rejects (the p13 warehouse_full / p22 multi-shelf failure mode).
leakage_note: A single junction has only 2 goal coordinates; to satisfy train>=12 / val>=4 / test>=6 with NO cross-split reuse of goals/coordinates, the dataset must draw from >=6 DISJOINT junction instances (see synthetic_fork_scene_spec.json min_dataset).
claim_boundary_statements: It is not real-scene / real-world evidence.
It is not promotion (DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_NOT_PROMOTED; incumbent retained).
It is not full goal-conditioned ImageNav evidence.
It carries no training authorization (training remains blocked).
CL_BOUND_XY is unchanged (6.0 m watchdog untouched).
One cross is not enough for a leakage-safe train/val/test split (a single junction has only two goal coordinates).
Future training requires a family of at least 6 disjoint junction instances (split by instance; no cross-split reuse of frames/goals/coordinates/instances).
